title: The task framing promised menu entries flagged '(as a Scout)' for class-specific finds, but that literal string never appeared in any menu across ~570 turns; Scout-favored content exists only implicitly as very generous grace-check DCs (e.g. 'trace the water verse by touch (grace) (DC 8, +5 grace: roll 3+ on the die)').
